fields.label: Email
fields.description: The mailbox address, e.g. alice@acme.com. Its domain must be a Mail Domain of the site. Cannot change after saving.

fields.label: Domain
fields.description: Mail Domain the address belongs to. Derived from the email.

fields.label: Site
fields.description: Suite site that owns the account. Derived from the domain; the site's account limit applies.

fields.label: Cluster
fields.description: Cluster the mailbox lives on. Derived from the site.
Untick to lock the account: it keeps receiving mail but can no longer log in, send or read. Tick again to restore it.
fields.label: Enabled
Display Name
fields.description: Name shown to other users, e.g. Alice Doe. This is the only text sent to the cluster for the account.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Internal note for operators, e.g. the team or purpose. Stays in Suite Cloud; the cluster never sees it.

fields.label: Stalwart ID
fields.description: Id of the account on the cluster. Set when it is created there.
Login password. Leave blank when creating to have one generated. Type a new one and save to reset it. It is pushed to the cluster and never stored here.
fields.label: Password

fields.description: Login the Suite site uses for this account's mail access. Minted on creation and handed to the site once; Rotate App Password replaces it and Show App Password reveals it.
fields.label: App Password

fields.description: Bearer token for this account's JMAP access. Created only on demand with Rotate API Key, which also replaces an existing one; Show API Key reveals it.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Mailbox size limit in GB, above 0. Defaults to the site's default quota. Counts against the site's total disk quota.
fields.label: Disk Quota (GB)
Locale
fields.description: Language tag for server-generated messages and folder names, e.g. en-US or de-DE.

fields.label: Time Zone
fields.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Blank uses the server's.

fields.label: Used Disk (bytes)
fields.description: Mailbox size as last reported by the cluster.

fields.label: Aliases
fields.description: Other addresses delivered to this mailbox. Each must be unique across the cluster and under one of the site's domains.

fields.label: Groups
fields.description: Mail Groups this account is a member of. Mail sent to a group reaches every member.
